verdict.probe_answer: The report correctly diagnoses the non-glob declared workspace member being dropped when its manifest fails parsing, and separately identifies the rustfmt failure. It did not attempt a code fix, so the fix-shape criterion is false.
verdict.rationale: Root cause matches: the engineer explains that 04c6b0b derives workspace_members only from manifests that parse and contain [package], so a declared malformed member like bad is skipped while good remains. Format issue matches: they identify a separate cargo fmt --check diff in the new test. No fix was attempted; the report explicitly says no changes were made, so there is no union-style code change to grade as matching.
